en.headline: Huanggang Port 20,000-person drill runs smoothly, ID or home-return permit accepted
en.dek: Security Secretary Chris Tang said the final large-scale pressure test with Shenzhen went as planned and opening timing will be decided jointly once conditions are met.
body: The Hong Kong government and Shenzhen authorities completed a joint pressure test at the rebuilt Huanggang Port on Saturday involving 20,000 civil servants and hundreds of vehicles, the largest mobilisation to date.

Security Secretary Chris Tang Ping-keung said the full-process drill, the last major exercise before opening, ran largely smoothly and orderly. Crossing times stayed under 15 minutes at peak, and the five-in-one vehicle inspection channels processed private cars in about one minute on average.

Tang announced that once the control point opens, travellers using automated channels will be free to present either a Hong Kong identity card or a Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao residents. Exact opening dates will be set after further talks with the Shenzhen side.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸兩萬人演練大致暢順 開通後可用身分證或回鄉證
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示今次為開通前最後一次大型動員演練，整體暢順有序，正式通關時間將與深方協商決定。
body: 特區政府今日聯同深圳相關單位於新皇崗口岸進行壓力測試，動員公務員人數增至兩萬人，並有約300輛公共交通工具及300輛私家車參與，測試口岸對大量持續客流的承載能力。
保安局局長鄧炳強表示，今次為計劃中最後一次大型動員演練，屬全流程壓力測試，首次開放所有出入境櫃位，運作大致暢順有序，過境時間最長不超過15分鐘。五合一車道實際過關時間平均約一分鐘，情況理想。
鄧炳強宣布，口岸正式開通後，市民使用自助通道時可自由選擇出示香港身分證或回鄉證。具體通關時間會與深方協商後再作決定。
